recognize_zh: C 圖周邊血嗜酸性球的顆粒大小與顏色不一，混有紫黑色嗜鹼樣顆粒與橘紅色顆粒，核分葉異常；A、B 圖電子顯微鏡下顆粒呈均質或斑駁、缺乏典型的中央結晶核心，代表嗜酸性球發育不良（dysplastic eosinophil），見於具 MDS 相關變化的 AML。
features: Wright-Giemsa (C): eosinophil with abnormal nuclear lobation and mixed granules, including dark purple basophilic-appearing granules among orange-red eosinophilic granules
Uneven granule distribution with areas of granule-poor cytoplasm
Transmission EM (A): whole eosinophil with numerous round, electron-dense cytoplasmic granules
EM detail (B, boxed area): granules of variable density lacking the well-defined central crystalline core typical of mature specific granules
Surrounding red cells show central refractile artifacts; not interpretable as specific inclusions
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear (panel C) shows an eosinophil with irregular nuclear lobation and heterogeneous cytoplasmic granules, with admixed dark purple, basophilic-staining (immature, pro-eosinophilic) granules among orange eosinophilic granules. Transmission electron microscopy (panels A and B) shows numerous round cytoplasmic granules that, at higher magnification, have mottled or homogeneous matrices without the typical electron-dense central crystalloid core. These light and ultrastructural findings indicate defective eosinophil granule maturation. In a patient with AML, findings are consistent with eosinophil dysplasia as part of myelodysplasia-related changes.

ddx.vs: Inv(16) AML shows abnormal eosinophil precursors with large purple-violet basophilic granules in the marrow, so cytogenetics/molecular testing for CBFB::MYH11 is needed to separate it.

ddx.dx: Normal eosinophil with overlapping basophilic granules
ddx.vs: Normal eosinophils have uniform orange-red refractile granules and bilobed nuclei; EM shows specific granules with a central crystalline core.
Basophils have large dark granules that obscure the nucleus and lack orange granules, whereas this cell contains mostly eosinophilic granules with only some immature basophilic ones.
Reactive eosinophils may be hypogranular or vacuolated but do not show persistent immature basophilic granules or loss of crystalloid cores with accompanying multilineage dysplasia.
